# GUARA Platform

> GUARA Platform is a software platform for Human-State Intelligence in critical operations. It interprets how human-state signals evolve over time using computer vision, temporal analysis, AI and local processing. Professional mobility is the first vertical; GUARA Professional is its first complete reference implementation. Software licensing, technology integration, OEM / Embedded partnerships and pilots are open conversations; integration tooling (SDK/API-style interfaces) is under development, not a finished product.
